notes.title: Best Game and Best Gameplay nominee at Game Access '25
notes.content:
[h2]Showcasing at Game Access '25 in Brno[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620389/a17a5a7f5bdb109dcbbe591ec5f0580ccb0c2717.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We spent three amazing days in Brno showcasing [i]Hordeguard[/i] at the Game Access '25 conference. We received a lot of valuable feedback from players who tried our game, which will help us improve it even further. A huge thank you to everyone who stopped by our indie booth and took the time to talk with us — it truly means a lot to us![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620389/40fbad57196a5f4849e82c8405ea7df280aeb669.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We didn’t take home any awards, but out of nearly 80 games, ours was the only one nominated in two categories (Best Game and Best Gameplay) — and that alone is a reason for us to celebrate![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620389/5c471c3456dc8bcbfb1722ec528ba5ce7c232ebf.png"][/img][/p][p]Big thanks to everyone who voted for our game during the conference!
[/p][p]David and Peter
Black Deer Games[/p]
